name: Non-Registration Change Detection Benchmark
description: In this study, we propose a novel remote sensing change detection task, non-registration change detection, to address the increasing number of emergencies such as natural disasters, anthropogenic accidents, and military strikes. First, in light of the limited discourse on the issue of non-registration change detection, we systematically propose eight scenarios that could arise in the real world and potentially contribute to the occurrence of non-registration problems. Second, we develop distinct image transformation schemes tailored to various scenarios to convert the available registration change detection dataset into a non-registration version. Finally, we demonstrate that non-registration change detection can cause catastrophic damage to the state-of-the-art methods. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ShanZard/NRCD.
reputation: A recent research benchmark highlighting robustness issues in remote sensing change detection under misregistration; currently of interest in a niche community concerned with disaster monitoring and robustness.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark created by transforming existing registered change-detection datasets into non-registered scenarios; focused on robustness to misregistration. Likely limited dataset size and scenario-specific transforms; intended to stress-test SOTA methods rather than serve as a large-scale standardized corpus.
